note: Literature establishes YWHAZ S230W as a gain-of-function variant hyperactivating the RAS-ERK pathway associated with a CFC-like RASopathy phenotype in Popov-Chang syndrome.

evidence.text: The S230W variant of YWHAZ enhances Raf-stimulated Erk phosphorylation and behaves as a gain-of-function mutation in the RAS-ERK pathway that underlies a cardiofaciocutaneous (CFC) syndrome phenotype.

source.quote: Our data provide strong support to the hypothesis that the S230W variant of YWHAZ is a gain-of-function mutation in the RAS-ERK pathway and may underlie a CFC phenotype.

evidence.text: Popov-Chang syndrome is linked to the YWHAZ Ser230Trp variant, exhibiting a gain-of-function effect with heightened Ras-Erk pathway signaling activity.
